About Us

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We partner with customers worldwide to help them access capital, manage risk, and drive growth. Through our trusted platforms, data, and expertise, we help support the stability and resilience of financial markets and the broader economy.

About the role

Join LSEG’s AI Group to explore how artificial intelligence can solve business problems and shape useful products. This graduate role combines AI thinking, research, quantitative analysis and product management. You will connect business and support teams with engineering colleagues to turn promising ideas into practical AI-enabled solutions.

 

What you will do

Research emerging AI capabilities and find opportunities to improve products, processes and support functions.
Work with collaborators to understand user needs, clarify problems and shape AI product requirements.
Assess when to build, adapt or leverage existing AI tools and models, considering value, feasibility and limitations.
Support product discovery, experimentation, testing and documentation; help hand over well-defined solutions to engineering teams.
Use data and evidence to challenge assumptions, evaluate outcomes and recommend next steps.
Collaborate across AI research, product, business and engineering teams; communicate insights clearly.
Help translate business intent into platform capabilities, identifying shared needs so AI solutions can be reused across LSEG’s groups.

 

What we are looking for

Practical AI exposure through a project, research, internship or self-directed work, supported by an understanding of AI or machine-learning fundamentals.
Strong analytical, numerical and critical-thinking skills; a research-led approach to unfamiliar problems.
A business and product mindset: curiosity about user needs, functional requirements and real-world impact.
Intellectual curiosity, initiative, good judgement and a willingness to experiment, learn and question results.
Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working across technical and non-technical teams.
An interest in how individual solutions fit into wider platforms, and how they can scale across a large organization

 

Education

Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Probability, Physics (including Quantum Physics), Computer Science or a related quantitative or research-focused subject area.

Evidence of meaningful AI application is essential, regardless of degree subject.

 

To be eligible you must be a graduate who has completed your studies in 2026 or a final year undergraduate or Master’s student and have completed all the requirements of your course before summer 2027. 

 

Useful, but not essential

Exposure to generative AI, large language models or AI agents; product management or design thinking; responsible AI principles; financial markets or financial data; or programming languages such as Python, R or SQL.

 

Application close: 31st December, however we recommend an early application because we consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend an early application.    

 

Recruitment Process:   

The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume.  

The next stage of the application process is an untimed Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG.  

The second stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style 

The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.  

 

Life at LSEG  

At LSEG, we provide our employees with a comprehensive benefits portfolio as part of a competitive total rewards package. Our benefit plans are designed to supplement the financial, emotional and physical wellbeing of our employees and their families at all stages of their life. We encourage an appreciative, collaborative and inclusive culture that promotes employee and organisational wellbeing.   

We believe in remunerating our people with a variety of attractive benefits such as:   

 

Emotional Wellbeing: Annual wellness allowance; Employee assistance programme  
Physical Wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance; Optional dental Insurance; Gym membership & discounts  
Financial Wellbeing: Life Insurance; Income protection; 401K 
Other benefits: MyOffers: access to a range of retail discounts 

Career Stage:

Associate

Compensation/Benefits Information:

LSEG is committed to offering competitive Compensation and Benefits. The anticipated base salary for this position is $62,800 - $104,600.

Please be aware base salary ranges may vary by geographic location, city and state.   In addition to our offered base salary, this role is eligible for our Variable Incentive Compensation plan.  Target variable compensation will be commensurate with the posted career stage.   Individual salary will be reflective of job related knowledge, skills and  equivalent experience.   LSEG roles (excluding internships and part-time roles of less than 20 hours per week) are typically eligible for inclusion in our LSEG Benefits program, which includes offerings of:   Annual Wellness Allowance, Paid time-off, Medical, Dental, Vision, Flex Spending & Health Savings Options, Prescription Drug plan, 401(K) Savings Plan and Company match.   LSEG’s Benefits plan also includes basic life insurance, disability benefits, emergency backup dependent care,  adoption assistance commuter assistance etc.

LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

 

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

 

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
